activity_summary: Before four the light was gone. From the window you had the frost on Crosby Place, and you named the man who lives there as no longer Mayor. You did not go across. The count stayed for after supper.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke from the window and stayed.

facets.activity: Saw the frost on Crosby Place

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A man lives there who is no longer Mayor.
